mods.title: Lumen
mods.description: Lumen is a project that lets you play various modern Call of Duty titles like Warzone 1, Cold War, Vanguard, and MWIII Warzone over a LAN connection with friends.

mods.title: S4-Mod
mods.description: S4-Mod allows you to play various versions of Call of Duty: Vanguard over a LAN connection with other players. Includes server browser support.

mods.title: IW8-Mod
mods.description: IW8-Mod is a preservation project that allows you to play various old and new versions of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Warzone 1 with friends over a LAN connection.

mods.title: Project-BO4 Shield
mods.description: A very experimental modification platform for Call of Duty®: Black Ops 4 run by the community, aiming at improving both functionality and performance of the original game.

mods.title: HMW
mods.description: This Mod Allow You To Play MW2/MW3 Remastered Using Cod4-Remastered , and revive old times!

mods.title: H2-Mod
mods.description: H2-Mod is a client for Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered that enables advanced features such as Cbuff and a developer console, along with full modding support. It allows you to customize your experience with mods including Spec Ops, Survival, weapons, scripts, and more.

mods.title: IW7-Mod
mods.description: IW7-Mod is a client for Call of Duty®: Infinite Warfare that adds dedicated servers, hands-on modding utilities, and custom mods that feature content like weapons, models, sounds, and more.

mods.title: H1-Mod
mods.description: H1-Mod is a modded client for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered. The client aims to provide a better-than-vanilla experience, with many quality-of-life features added.

mods.title: AlterWare (Multiple Games)
mods.description: AlterWare is a Client For Black Ops 3, Ghosts, Advanced Warfare, and Modern Warfare 2 SinglePlayer.

mods.title: Plutonium (Multiple Games)
mods.description: Plutonium offers a unique Black Ops 2, Modern Warfare 3 & World at War experience, complete with dedicated servers, mod support, and much more.

mods.title: T6SP-Mod
mods.description: T6SP-Mod is a single-player modification for Call of Duty: Black Ops II.

mods.title: IW4X
mods.description: IW4x is a community-driven modification for Call of Duty Modern Warfare 2 (2009) that enhances the game with improved security, dedicated servers, and extensive modding capabilities.

mods.title: IW3SP-Mod
mods.description: Singleplayer client modification for Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (IW3). This client based on the IW4x Client.
